source_caption_text:
One of the only rappers who don’t need autotune 😮‍💨

King Von, born Dayvon Daquan Bennett, was an American rapper from the South Side of Chicago associated with the drill music scene.

Growing up in the Parkway Garden Homes complex, locally known as O-Block, he faced legal troubles early in life. After spending years in prison on charges he was later acquitted of, he turned to music around 2018 under the guidance of his childhood friend and fellow Chicago artist Lil Durk.

He quickly gained national attention through his distinct, vivid storytelling style, often delivering intense narratives about street life in Chicago. His breakthrough hit, “Crazy Story,” followed by his debut studio album *Welcome to O’Block* in 2020, established him as a prominent figure in modern hip-hop. Shortly after the release of his album in November 2020, his life was cut short when he was shot and killed outside a night club in Atlanta, Georgia, at the age of 26.
